name: ASUS TUF Gaming A16 FA608UH-RV007W Ryzen 7 260 RTX 5050 8GB Gaming Laptop
shortDescription: ASUS TUF Gaming A16 FA608UH-RV007W Gaming Laptop (AMD Ryzen 7 260 8-Core Processor / NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5050 8GB GDDR6 115W TGP / 16GB DDR5 5600MHz RAM / 512GB NVMe PCIe Gen4 SSD / 16-inch FHD+ 1920x1200 165Hz 100% sRGB
descriptionHtml:
ASUS TUF Gaming A16 FA608UH-RV007W Gaming Laptop (AMD Ryzen 7 260 8-Core Processor / NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5050 8GB GDDR6 115W TGP / 16GB DDR5 5600MHz RAM / 512GB NVMe PCIe Gen4 SSD / 16-inch FHD+ 1920x1200 165Hz 100% sRGB IPS Display / RGB Backlit Keyboard / 90Wh Battery / Windows 11 Home / 1 Year Perfect Warranty Pro)

Elevate your gaming and content creation performance with the ASUS TUF Gaming A16 FA608UH-RV007W laptop, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with a 1-Year Perfect Warranty Pro. Powered by the high-performance AMD Ryzen 7 260 8-core processor and paired with the high-TGP NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5050 8GB graphics card running up to 115W, this 16-inch gaming powerhouse handles AAA gaming and intensive multitasking effortlessly. Featuring a 16-inch 165Hz FHD+ display with 100% sRGB color gamut coverage, 16GB high-speed DDR5 memory, 512GB Gen4 NVMe storage, a large 90Wh battery, and military-grade durability, it delivers immersive visuals and long-lasting reliability.
